control.description-key: Virtual PCF: 11-entity regarding picker bound to sprk_regardingrecordtype; wraps applyResolverFields (ADR-024) — HOST-only (sprk_todo, sprk_communication per FR-22); do NOT bind to target entities like sprk_matter/sprk_event

property.name: regardingRecordType
property.description-key: Lookup to sprk_recordtype_ref — the resolver discriminator. Bind to the host entity sprk_regardingrecordtype hidden lookup field.

property.name: entity
property.description-key: Dataverse logical name of the host entity (sprk_todo or sprk_communication). FR-22 reusability lever — set once per form, no entity-specific code branches in the PCF.

property.name: regardingTargets
property.description-key: Optional comma-separated list of allowed parent entity logical names. Defaults to: sprk_matter,sprk_project,sprk_event,sprk_communication,sprk_workassignment,sprk_invoice,sprk_budget,sprk_analysis,sprk_organization,contact,sprk_document

property.name: readOnly
property.description-key: When true, renders selected target as read-only link without edit affordances (FR-24). Auto-detected from form-disabled state when omitted.

property.name: regardingRecordNumberField
property.description-key: Bound to the host entity record-number text column (default sprk_regardingrecordnumber). Renders as the Row-2 hyperlink placeholder. Maker can rebind on a new host entity without code change (FR-A1-02).

property.name: regardingRecordNameField
property.description-key: Bound to the host entity record-name text column (default sprk_regardingrecordname). Kept for backward-compat with v1.3.0 form bindings; not rendered in v1.3.1 (record-name is displayed via a separate OOB field on the form).

property.name: title
property.description-key: Row-1 title text (FR-A1-01). Default: RELATED RECORD. Rendered uppercased regardless of input.

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer at the bottom of the control. Set to false to hide the footer for production forms where operators do not need to see the build version.
